meta.name: ai-sdk-docs-bot-evals-v7-hard
meta.notes: 72 answerable + 3 unanswerable. Harder set: v6->v7 version traps, behavior/default changes, agents and tool approvals, multi-hop, code rewrites, false premises (answerable: the bot must correct the premise). Written from the live docs on 2026-11-06; the bot snapshot is from 2026-11-01. Questions duplicating ai-sdk-evals.json were removed. Same field semantics as ai-sdk-evals.json.

questions.question: How do I generate an image with the AI SDK v7? Which function do I import?
expected_answer: Use `generateImage` from 'ai'
The v6 name `experimental_generateImage` was removed in v7

questions.question: In v7, what is `experimental_customProvider` called, and did its options change?
expected_answer: It is now `customProvider`; the experimental name was removed
Options are unchanged

questions.question: Does `experimental_transcribe` still work in v7?
expected_answer: The stable name is `transcribe`
`experimental_transcribe` still works but only as a deprecated alias (same for `Experimental_TranscriptionResult` -> `TranscriptionResult`)

questions.question: What is the v7 name for `experimental_generateSpeech` and its result type?
expected_answer: `generateSpeech` and `SpeechResult`
The experimental names remain as deprecated aliases

questions.question: I used `experimental_output` with generateText and read `result.experimental_output`. What do I use in v7?
expected_answer: The option is `output` and the result field is `result.output`
Both experimental names were removed

questions.question: Are `experimental_prepareStep` and `experimental_activeTools` still valid in v7?
expected_answer: No
They were removed; use `prepareStep` and `activeTools`

questions.question: What type replaces `ToolCallOptions` in v7?
expected_answer: `ToolExecutionOptions`
`ToolCallOptions` was removed

questions.question: `isToolOrDynamicToolUIPart` no longer exists. What should I use?
expected_answer: `isToolUIPart`

questions.question: What are `experimental_onStart` and `experimental_onStepStart` called in v7?
expected_answer: `onStart` and `onStepStart`

questions.question: In v7, which callback fires when streamText finishes? Is `onFinish` still accepted?
expected_answer: `onEnd`
`onFinish` is still accepted as a deprecated alias; if both are given, `onEnd` wins
Applies to streamText, Agent.generate(), Agent.stream() and ToolLoopAgent

questions.question: What replaces `onStepFinish` in v7?
expected_answer: `onStepEnd`
`onStepFinish` remains a deprecated alias for user callbacks; telemetry integrations should implement `onStepEnd`

questions.question: How do I run a callback when `embedMany` completes in v7?
expected_answer: Pass the per-call `onEnd` option
In v6 it was `experimental_onFinish`
Same change applies to `embed` and `rerank`

questions.question: Where are reasoning token counts in the v7 usage object?
expected_answer: `usage.outputTokenDetails.reasoningTokens`
The top-level `usage.reasoningTokens` was removed

questions.question: What is the v7 name of the `experimental_telemetry` option?
expected_answer: `telemetry`
`experimental_telemetry` still works as a deprecated alias

questions.question: My telemetry integration implements `onEmbedFinish` and `onRerankFinish`. What changes in v7?
expected_answer: They become `onEmbedEnd` and `onRerankEnd`
The `type` field on `AI_SDK_TELEMETRY_TRACING_CHANNEL` events changes to match, so subscribers must be updated

questions.question: How do I get raw provider chunks from streamText in v7?
expected_answer: Set `include: { rawChunks: true }`
The top-level `includeRawChunks` option is deprecated

questions.question: What happened to `experimental_include` in v7?
expected_answer: It was renamed to `include`
If both are set, `include` wins

questions.question: Which callbacks fire when a tool starts and finishes executing in v7?
expected_answer: `onToolExecutionStart` and `onToolExecutionEnd` (formerly `experimental_onToolCallStart` / `experimental_onToolCallFinish`, which are now fallbacks only)

questions.question: Inside a tool's execute function, how do I read the context in v7? Is it still `experimental_context`?
expected_answer: No
It is the stable `context`, read from the destructured execute options
Per-tool context is declared with `contextSchema` on `tool()` and supplied via `toolsContext`

questions.question: Is `createGoogleGenerativeAI` still the way to configure the Google provider in v7?
expected_answer: It is a deprecated alias
Use `createGoogle` (and `GoogleProvider` instead of `GoogleGenerativeAIProvider`)
The `google` constant is unchanged
A codemod `rename-google-generative-ai-to-google` exists

questions.question: How do I send an image in a user message in v7? Is `{ type: 'image', image }` still recommended?
expected_answer: The `image` part is deprecated
Use `{ type: 'file', mediaType: 'image', data }`

questions.question: My tool returns a `media` tool result part. What do I use in v7?
expected_answer: The `media` part was removed
Use `{ type: 'file', mediaType, data: { type: 'data', data } }`

questions.question: Is there an automated way to migrate a codebase from AI SDK 6 to 7?
expected_answer: Yes: run `npx @ai-sdk/codemod v7` for all codemods, or `npx @ai-sdk/codemod v7/<codemod-name> <path>` for one
There is also a migration skill: `npx skills add vercel/ai --skill migrate-ai-sdk-v6-to-v7`

questions.question: If prepareStep returns instructions on step 2, do they apply to step 3 as well in v7?
expected_answer: Yes
In v7 returned instructions carry forward until overridden (in v6 they applied only to the current step). prepareStep receives `instructions` and `initialInstructions`
To get one-step-only behavior, return instructions explicitly every step

questions.question: What happens to messages returned from prepareStep in v7 on later steps?
expected_answer: They become the base for later steps, plus the previous step's response messages
To keep v6 behavior, rebuild from `initialMessages` and `responseMessages` each step

questions.question: In a multi-step generateText call in v7, does `result.toolCalls` contain tool calls from all steps or just the last one?
expected_answer: All steps
In v7 `content`, `toolCalls`, `toolResults` (and static/dynamic variants), `files`, `sources` and `warnings` accumulate across steps
Use `finalStep.toolCalls` for the last step only

questions.question: Where do I read `reasoningText` and `providerMetadata` in v7?
expected_answer: On `result.finalStep` (`finalStep.reasoningText`, `finalStep.providerMetadata`)
Along with `reasoning`, `request` and `response`, the top-level versions are deprecated

questions.question: With streamText in v7, how do I read the final step's response metadata?
expected_answer: The values are async: `await result.finalStep` first, then read `.response` (and other final-step properties)

questions.question: How do I enable or disable telemetry for a single call in v7?
expected_answer: Telemetry is opt-out in v7: once an integration (e.g. OpenTelemetry, DevToolsTelemetry) is registered, all calls emit events
Remove `isEnabled: true`; opt out per call with `isEnabled: false`
To disable globally, register no integrations

questions.question: Where do I pass a custom OpenTelemetry tracer in v7?
expected_answer: `tracer` was removed from the telemetry call option
Pass it to the constructor: `new OpenTelemetry({ tracer })` from `@ai-sdk/otel`
Default is `trace.getTracer('ai')`

questions.question: My streamText `onChunk` handler started receiving unexpected chunk types after upgrading to v7. Why?
expected_answer: In v7 `onChunk` receives all `TextStreamPart` types (e.g. start, start-step, text-start, text-end, reasoning-start/end, tool-input-end, finish-step, finish, abort, error)
Guard on `chunk.type`

questions.question: Why is `response.body` empty on my generateText result in v7, and how do I get it back?
expected_answer: Request and response bodies are excluded by default
Opt in with `include: { requestBody: true, responseBody: true }`
For streamText only `requestBody` is available

questions.question: My MCP HTTP server sits behind a redirect and stopped working after upgrading to v7. Why?
expected_answer: The `redirect` default on `MCPTransportConfig` (HTTP and SSE) changed from 'follow' to 'error' to block SSRF-style redirects
Set `redirect: 'follow'` explicitly

questions.question: After upgrading, the OpenAI Responses models return detailed reasoning summaries I didn't ask for. Why, and how do I turn it off?
expected_answer: In v7, setting `reasoning` or `reasoningEffort` to anything other than 'none' defaults `reasoningSummary` to 'detailed'
Set `providerOptions.openai.reasoningSummary` to `null` to disable

questions.question: Which xAI API does `xai(modelId)` use in v7, and how do I keep using Chat Completions?
expected_answer: `xai(modelId)` and `xai.languageModel(modelId)` now use the Responses API
Use `xai.chat(modelId)` for Chat Completions

questions.question: How do I get Anthropic cache creation tokens in v7?
expected_answer: `providerMetadata.anthropic.cacheCreationInputTokens` was removed
Use `usage.inputTokenDetails.cacheWriteTokens` (and `cacheReadTokens`)
The raw payload is still at `finalStep.providerMetadata?.anthropic?.usage`

questions.question: I set the top-level `reasoning` option but also have reasoning settings in providerOptions. Which wins?
expected_answer: Provider settings take precedence and can silently override `reasoning`
Remove overlapping reasoning settings from providerOptions;
`reasoning` is the provider-agnostic control

questions.question: What is the new `reasoning-file` part type in v7 and what do I need to update?
expected_answer: A new content part type for files referenced in reasoning
Handle it in exhaustive unions, switches, validators, renderers and serializers
Such files no longer duplicate into `result.files` / `step.files`

questions.question: Should I still use the `Chat` class from @ai-sdk/vue in v7?
expected_answer: No, it is deprecated
Use the `useChat` composable (reactive messages, status, error, sendMessage)
Pass a getter, e.g. `useChat(() => ({ ... }))`, so the chat is recreated when inputs change

questions.question: Is `result.toTextStreamResponse()` still recommended on streamText results in v7?
expected_answer: No
The streamText result methods are deprecated (warnings, removal next major)
Use `createTextStreamResponse({ stream: toTextStream({ stream }) })` imported from 'ai'

questions.question: Does WorkflowAgent have a default step limit?
expected_answer: Per the WorkflowAgent reference: generate() defaults to 20 steps, stream() has no maximum when stopWhen is omitted
Bound it with isStepCount(n)
The loop-control guide says WorkflowAgent has no default step limit; an answer following either page is acceptable if it doesn't contradict both

questions.question: How do I stop an agent loop when either 20 steps pass or a tool named 'done' is called?
expected_answer: Pass an array to `stopWhen`: `[isStepCount(20), hasToolCall('done')]`
The loop stops when any condition is met

questions.question: How do I let a ToolLoopAgent run until the model finishes on its own, without the default step cap?
expected_answer: Use `stopWhen: isLoopFinished()`
It never triggers, so the loop runs until the model naturally finishes, and it removes the ToolLoopAgent default limit

questions.question: Under what conditions does the tool loop end, apart from stop conditions?
expected_answer: When the finish reason is not tool calls, when an invoked tool has no `execute` function, or when a tool call needs approval (plus when a stop condition is met)

questions.question: How can I force an agent to always end by returning a structured final answer through a tool?
expected_answer: Set `toolChoice: 'required'` and add a `done` tool with an inputSchema but no `execute`
The loop stops when the model calls it; read the answer from `result.staticToolCalls`

questions.question: What can prepareStep change for an individual step?
expected_answer: prepareStep can return per-step overrides such as `model`, `messages`, `activeTools` and `toolChoice`
Step-scoped call settings (e.g. temperature, maxOutputTokens, reasoning) can also be overridden
Per the v7 migration guide, returned `instructions` are supported and carry forward; `runtimeContext` is visible in prepareStep
Omitted fields keep the top-level values
Do not mark other fields wrong unless they contradict the docs; the reference list is not exhaustive

questions.question: How do I compact the message history between agent steps?
expected_answer: Return `messages` from prepareStep, using `pruneMessages({ messages, reasoning, toolCalls, emptyMessages })`

questions.question: What values can a toolApproval setting return, and what does each do?
expected_answer: 'not-applicable' (default, runs normally), 'approved' (records automatic approval, runs), 'denied' (records denial, returns denied output), 'user-approval' (emits approval request and waits). approved/denied also have an object form with a reason; returning undefined equals 'not-applicable'

questions.question: Does toolApproval apply to provider-executed tools?
expected_answer: No
It only applies to tools the AI SDK executes

questions.question: Chat history comes from the client. How do I stop users from forging tool approvals?
expected_answer: Set `experimental_toolApprovalSecret`: the server HMAC-signs approval requests and verifies them on replay; unsigned or invalid approvals are rejected (fail-closed)
Every server instance needs the same secret

questions.question: How do I show and answer a tool approval request in a useChat UI?
expected_answer: The tool part (type `tool-<toolName>`) has `state: 'approval-requested'` and an `approval` object (id, isAutomatic, requestReason)
Respond with `addToolApprovalResponse({ id, approved })`; use `sendAutomaticallyWhen: lastAssistantMessageIsCompleteWithApprovalResponses` to continue automatically
Only call it for manual approvals

questions.question: Without useChat, how do I resume an agent after the user approves a tool call?
expected_answer: Find `tool-approval-request` parts (each has `approvalId`), push a `role: 'tool'` message containing `tool-approval-response` objects (`approvalId`, `approved`, optional `reason`), then call the agent again; the approved tool runs on that call

questions.question: Is `needsApproval` used anywhere in v7?
expected_answer: Only with WorkflowAgent, where approvals suspend and resume durable execution
For generateText, streamText and ToolLoopAgent it is deprecated in favor of toolApproval

questions.question: How do I require approval for a payment tool only when the amount is above $100?
expected_answer: Use a per-tool approval function in `toolApproval`, e.g. `{ pay: ({ amount }) => amount > 100 ? 'user-approval' : undefined }`
The function receives the typed input plus toolCallId, messages, toolContext and runtimeContext

questions.question: My v6 agent uses `stopWhen: stepCountIs(5)`, reads `experimental_context` inside tools and logs in `onFinish`. What do I change for v7?
expected_answer: `stepCountIs` -> `isStepCount`;
`experimental_context` -> `context` (declare per-tool shape with `contextSchema`, pass values via `toolsContext`, shared state via `runtimeContext`);
`onFinish` -> `onEnd`

questions.question: In v7, inside onEnd, how do I log total cached and reasoning tokens for the whole multi-step run?
expected_answer: `event.usage` now totals all steps: `event.usage.inputTokenDetails.cacheReadTokens` and `event.usage.outputTokenDetails.reasoningTokens`

questions.question: I'm upgrading a Next.js app that used `experimental_telemetry: { isEnabled: true, tracer }`. What are all the steps for v7?
expected_answer: Install `@ai-sdk/otel`; call `registerTelemetry(new OpenTelemetry({ tracer }))` once at startup (in instrumentation.ts); rename `experimental_telemetry` to `telemetry`; remove `isEnabled: true` (opt-out now) and `tracer` from the call; keep functionId etc

questions.question: In v7 I need a per-tool API key for my `search` tool and a shared userId that the tool also needs. I put userId in runtimeContext — why can't the tool see it?
expected_answer: In v7 tool callbacks no longer read the shared `runtimeContext`; it is for generation/agent state (prepareStep, events, steps)
Declare `contextSchema` on the tool (including userId and apiKey) and pass values via `toolsContext: { search: { ... } }`
If any tool declares contextSchema, toolsContext is required

questions.question: In v6 my prepareStep returned `system` only on step 0 to set a special first-step prompt. Will this behave the same in v7?
expected_answer: No
Use `instructions` instead of `system`, and in v7 returned instructions carry forward to later steps until overridden
Return instructions explicitly on every step (e.g. `initialInstructions` after step 0) to keep v6 behavior

questions.question: For debugging in v7 I want streamText to give me raw provider chunks and the request body. What do I set?
expected_answer: `include: { rawChunks: true, requestBody: true }`
(responseBody is only available for generateText.)

questions.question: In v7, how do I get token usage for only the last step of a streamText call, as opposed to the whole run?
expected_answer: `await result.finalStep` then read `.usage` for the last step
`result.usage` totals all steps
`system` -> `instructions`;
`experimental_include` -> `include`;
`onStepFinish` -> `onStepEnd`;
`onFinish` -> `onEnd`;
`result.fullStream` -> `result.stream`
Remove `needsApproval`; add `toolApproval: { deleteFile: 'user-approval' }` on the agent
Declare `contextSchema: z.object({ root: z.string() })` on the tool, read `context` in execute, and pass `toolsContext: { deleteFile: { root: '/data' } }`
Top-level `context` is renamed `runtimeContext` and is not visible to tools
`stepCountIs(3)` -> `isStepCount(3)`;
`r.totalUsage.cachedInputTokens` -> `r.usage.inputTokenDetails.cacheReadTokens`;
`r.usage.reasoningTokens` -> `r.usage.outputTokenDetails.reasoningTokens` (note usage is now all steps; use r.finalStep.usage for last step only);
`r.reasoningText` -> `r.finalStep.reasoningText`

questions.question: Write a v7 ToolLoopAgent with a `search` tool that stops after 10 steps or when a `done` tool is called, and only allows `search` with a required tool call on the first step.
expected_answer: new ToolLoopAgent({ model, tools: { search, done }, stopWhen: [isStepCount(10), hasToolCall('done')], prepareStep: ({ stepNumber }) => stepNumber === 0 ? { activeTools: ['search'], toolChoice: 'required' } : {} }), with `done` defined via tool() without execute

questions.question: Rewrite this tool result content part for v7: `{ type: 'image-url', url: 'https://example.com/a.png' }`
expected_answer: `{ type: 'file', mediaType: 'image', data: { type: 'url', url: new URL('https://example.com/a.png') } }`
The image-*/file-* variants are deprecated (runtime auto-migration exists)

questions.question: Rewrite for v7 without deprecated result methods: `return streamText({ model, prompt }).toTextStreamResponse();`
expected_answer: const { stream } = streamText({ model, prompt }); return createTextStreamResponse({ stream: toTextStream({ stream }) }); — both helpers imported from 'ai'

questions.question: Rewrite for v7: `import { createGoogleGenerativeAI } from '@ai-sdk/google'; const g = createGoogleGenerativeAI({ apiKey });`
expected_answer: `import { createGoogle } from '@ai-sdk/google'; const g = createGoogle({ apiKey });` (old name still works as deprecated alias; codemod rename-google-generative-ai-to-google)

questions.question: In v7, where do I put `isEnabled: true` to turn telemetry on?
expected_answer: Premise is outdated: telemetry is opt-out in v7
Registering an integration (registerTelemetry with OpenTelemetry) enables it for all calls; remove `isEnabled: true`
`isEnabled: false` opts a call out

questions.question: What do I need to configure to run AI SDK v7 on Node 20?
expected_answer: Node 20 is not supported in v7;
Node 22 or later is required (24 LTS or 26 preferred)

questions.question: How do I read `runtimeContext` inside a tool's execute function in v7?
expected_answer: You can't: tool callbacks no longer read the shared runtimeContext
Use `contextSchema` + `toolsContext` and read `context` in execute

questions.question: How do I configure toolApproval for subagent tools in v7?
expected_answer: Subagent tools cannot use toolApproval

questions.question: How much does Mistral Small cost per million tokens when called through the AI SDK?
expected_answer: Pricing is set by providers, not documented by the AI SDK; the bot should say so

questions.question: How many GitHub stars does the AI SDK repository have?
expected_answer: Not in the docs; the bot should decline

questions.question: How do I configure the AI SDK's built-in vector database for RAG?
expected_answer: The docs describe no built-in vector database (VERIFY)
The bot should say so instead of inventing an API; it may point to embeddings + an external store
